content:
Rae: opened a small PR to add an 'egress checklist' and a tiny SDK example for HSM key lookup in private installs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2891
Owen: Nice. Could we include a short migration note for customers moving from peering to Transit Gateway and a sample route change? Keep it non-cloud-provider-specific.
Rae: Will add a route diff and a short BGP AS placeholder example.
Mona: For on-prem firewalls, can we show both nftables and an iptables fallback? I'll paste minimal snippets.
Mona: nftables (ubuntu22):
```
add table inet redwood_kms
add chain inet redwood_kms input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
add rule inet redwood_kms input ct state established,related accept
add rule inet redwood_kms input ip saddr 10.250.0.0/24 tcp dport 23456 accept
```
Mona: iptables fallback:
```
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.250.0.0/24 --dport 23456 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
```
Kai: Add a systemd override snippet to keep the kms-proxy healthy on flaky links and a logrotate example.
Kai: systemd hint:
```
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/proxy.env
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
LimitNOFILE=65536
```
Kai: logrotate (/etc/logrotate.d/redwood-proxy): `rotate 7`
Rae: SDK snippet for key lookup (python) - keep it tiny and use placeholders:
```
from redwood import KMSClient
client = KMSClient(endpoint='https://kms.internal')
key = client.get_key('redwood-hsm-readonly')
print(key.id)
```
Priya: Editorial: standardize headings to uppercase HSM, use "Transit Gateway" consistently, and avoid real ARNs/slot IDs. Also recommend TLS_KEY_PATH instead of embedding private keys in env.
Rae: Good call 1 will scrub identifiers and switch to TLS_KEY_PATH.
Owen: For air-gapped customers, include both `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256`. Also show `curl --resolve` healthcheck example.
Mona: curl healthcheck: `curl -v --resolve hsm:23456:10.250.0.12 https://hsm/health`
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck failed -> docs/private/egress.md '#peering-vs-tgw' missing (job #944)
Rae: Adding anchor and a short decision table (peering: simple, per-VPC; Transit Gateway: scalable, centralized). Pushing commit now.
DocsBot: CI: lint warning -> inconsistent HSM casing in docs/onprem/install.md (warning).
Priya: I'll run a heading sweep and fix casing.
Rae: Pushed fixes. Tests passing. Ready to merge after one review.
Owen: Happy to review. I'll check the migration wording and the SDK example for safety.
Priya: Security note: ensure PKCS#11 examples use placeholders and advise redaction of real slot numbers.
Rae: Replaced slot IDs with `<SLOT_PLACEHOLDER>` and added backport to release/1.2.x.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed, ready to merge.
Owen: LGTM.
Rae: Merged and backported. Adding changelog entry: "docs: egress checklist, nftables/iptables examples, systemd/logrotate hints, SDK key lookup sample, peering->Transit Gateway migration note (backported v1.2)"
Mona: :thumbsup: Closing thread.
